sentences.en: It was very sensible of him to reject the bribe.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝贿赂是非常明智的。

sentences.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
sentences.zh: 该法案的说客将贿赂资金注入了竞选基金。

sentences.en: Bribes are something that arises in conjunction with power organizations.
sentences.zh: 贿赂是与权力组织相伴而生的问题。
